name: Westminster grounds, former footprint
summary: Former footprint showing continuous lawn and tree branches in 2025 imagery. The foreground garage in the selected older street frame is a separate footprint.

evidence.note: The 2025 image shows lawn and a branching tree across the footprint. No eaves or roof surfaces.
Foreground wide garage matches w778713980 only 19 m from this camera. This footprint is about 71 m away and behind it.
P50 5.74 m and P90 6.27 m may preserve an earlier roof. The present orthophoto shows lawn.

notes: The survey models the landscape shown in the 2025 orthophoto. The former building has no established name or facade finish.
